text: Retract the path traversal suspicion. The route `/v1/engine/model` calls `model_path()`, which returns `Path(self.config['draft_model'])`. This value is set exclusively via the admin handler, which validates the input against a local catalog of existing files. The node endpoint accepts no user-supplied path parameters. Since the path is fixed by the owner's prior admin action and not influenced by the node request, arbitrary filesystem access is impossible.
